chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.236.3

## [1.236.3](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.236.2...v1.236.3) (2026-11-21)

### Bug Fixes

* **daemon:** every clock task's throw reaches the bar ([#925](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/925)) ([1c9001a](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/1c9001abf07cdf49706032b66a888807190c0a6b))

fix(renderer): an entry's config facts are read off its one applied load

An entry's public face is its snapshot, diagnostics and state, all read off
the one applied load the cache alone replaces. The cache's comments keep each
reason and drop the dated measurements, history and ticket ids beside it.
wip(renderer): checkpoint config attempt ownership for handoff
test(config): load an actual absent user layer (ibyq.xrv)
test(daemon): verify the click's exact mailbox wait (ibyq.xrv)
test(proc): release launcher fixtures with their Jest runtime (ibyq.xrv)
test(daemon): prove pane subscriber disconnect cleanup (ibyq.xrv)
test(renderer): bind sample payloads in fixtures (ibyq.xrv)
test(daemon): report an explicit session environment (ibyq.xrv)

fix(config): one key classifier, one write router, and Back steps that end with their edit

What a session key is (edit mode's own, a setting, a confirm, the
viewer, a menu, an author's) is decided by one function, and every
reader and writer switches on it. Every session write passes one
router: an open edit holds it, and with none open edit mode's keys are
set aside for the edit a click opens, or dropped and logged. An edit
holds the Back steps taken in it, and the click that ends it lands its
own step outside, without edit mode's keys. Whether an edit has work is
the files it changed and the drafts a save writes, one count for the
save cell, cancel and the idle close. The duplicate-id hint is fixed
text, the click error reads only records this build writes, and a
session left empty by the load takes no slot.

fix(config): decide edit-or-store once per click and check authored keys wherever they load

A click outside an edit holds edit mode's keys aside: they open the edit
it starts, or are dropped and logged at warn. Every reader takes the
edit's view, the main undo never records an edit key, and drafts are
neither main-undo nor navigation state. A closed edit's steps are never
Back destinations because its state never reaches the store.

The authored-key check runs for plugins too, refuses raw keys by
namespace and accordion keys only where they meet the bar's own. The
click error lives under the settings namespace. Hover text decodes menu
keys. Minted placement ids retry a bounded number of times and throw.
fix(config): give re-added placements a fresh id and keep edit-mode state in the edit

fix(settings): fold every pick through one setting table and warn on stale picks

A session pick its setting can no longer hold (an uninstalled or retired theme, an undeclared style or preset, a dropped effect, an out-of-range value, a placement value outside its declaration) now reads through its setting's one parse as stale. The fold draws what lies beneath it and reports which rung decided, and the frame shows one stale warning per stale pick that decided, naming the setting, the spelling held, what the bar wears and what the setting can hold. Every save releases every pick that is not a draft against the config it wrote, and a state variable may no longer read a setting's session key.
